title: Agent Skill frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file. The field set is closed: additional properties are rejected.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must equal the parent directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Drives triggering.

license.description: License name or a reference to a bundled license file.

metadata.description: Arbitrary string-to-string pairs for client-specific data.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated list of pre-approved tools. Experimental.
